## Description

Learns time-varying latent structural stock graphs without relying on static predefined sector taxonomies, applying message-passing graph neural networks for cross-sectional alpha prediction.

## Where it may fit

Broad cross-sectional equity universes (e.g. S&P 500, Russell 1000), structural sector convergence/divergence.

## Vehicles

Quantitative long/short equity hedge funds, systematic equity alpha funds.

## Required data

Stock fundamental factor panels, price time series, trading volume, cross-sectional return panels.

## Caveats

Dynamic graph adjacency learning requires attention mechanism regularization to prevent over-smoothing.
